tagline: D.R. Horton, Inc. is the largest homebuilding company in the United States as measured by number of homes closed.
hero_kpi_rationale: The number of homes closed is the primary indicator of DHI's activity and scale, reflecting its undisputed leadership position in the U.S. residential construction market.

kpis.name: Homes Closed
kpis.explanation: Total number of homes sold and delivered by the company during a fiscal year.
kpis.description: This KPI measures the volume of completed sales, reflecting the company's ability to meet demand in the housing market.
kpis.signal: Key volume indicator in residential construction.

kpis.name: Homebuilding Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the core home construction and sales business.
kpis.description: Represents the majority of the company's revenue, directly tied to sales volume and home pricing.
kpis.signal: Reflects the financial performance of the core business activity.

kpis.name: Consolidated Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total revenue of the company, including all business activities.
kpis.description: Includes revenue from homebuilding, rental, and financial services, providing a comprehensive view of company operations.
kpis.signal: Overall indicator of company size and growth.

kpis.name: Pre-tax Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profitability before taxes, expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Indicates the margin generated from core operations before tax deductions.
kpis.signal: Measures operational efficiency before tax impact.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Final profit of the company after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Represents the actual profit distributed to shareholders or reinvested in the business.

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.explanation: Earnings attributable to each outstanding common share, after dilution.
kpis.description: Indicates the portion of net income per share, accounting for potentially dilutive shares.
kpis.signal: Measures profitability per share for investors.

kpis.name: Net cash from operations
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from the company's primary operating activities.
kpis.description: Shows cash available from core operations, essential for financing, investment, and debt repayment.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of the company's ability to generate liquidity.

kpis.name: Return on Equity
kpis.explanation: Measures profitability generated on shareholders' equity investment.
kpis.description: Assesses how effectively the company uses shareholder funds to generate profits.

kpis.name: Home sales gross margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin specific to home sales activity, before other expenses.
kpis.description: Measures the margin achieved on home sales, influenced by construction costs and selling prices.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of direct profitability from home sales.

kpis.name: Average Closing Price
kpis.explanation: Average price at which homes were sold during the fiscal year.
kpis.description: This KPI reflects the average value of homes sold, influenced by property type and market conditions.
kpis.signal: Indicates real estate price trends and product positioning.

kpis.name: Lots controlled through purchase contracts
kpis.explanation: Percentage of lots whose acquisition is secured through purchase contracts.
kpis.description: Shows the proportion of land where the company has secured control, reducing future supply risk.
kpis.signal: Indicator of land inventory management strategy.

kpis.short: Homes closed on lots developed by Forestar or third party
kpis.name: Homes closed on lots developed by Forestar or third party
kpis.explanation: Percentage of homes closed on lots developed by external partners or Forestar.
kpis.description: Measures the use of lots from Forestar (subsidiary) or other developers, reflecting land sourcing strategy.
kpis.signal: Indicates reliance and collaboration with external developers.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Total Revenue of $34.25 Bn last year.

risks.title: High interest rates affecting demand
risks.score_rationale: The risk is placed at the top of the document and described as having a direct impact on home affordability, with strong language on price adjustments and incentives. The impact is existential as it relates to the major economic cycle of the real estate sector. The Macro category is highly weighted.

ai_positioning.summary: DHI does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its report. There is no indication of its involvement in the AI field.
